instances.spoken_text: Segment A has nine hundred thousand people; twenty-five percent buy six times yearly at twenty-five dollars. Segment B has six hundred thousand people; sixty percent buy three times yearly at ten dollars. What is combined annual spending, in millions of dollars?

follow_up.question: Why size the two segments separately?
follow_up.reference: Their buyer rates, purchase frequencies or prices differ. Combining them too early can apply an average assumption to the wrong weight and distort total spending.
